description.value: In areas of bright light, holy elementals are invisible. As with greater invisibility, they may attack and still remain invisible. In shadowy illumination, a holy elemental loses this invisibility, though like all creatures in shadows, they have concealment unless the viewer has darkvision.

effect: Invisible in bright light even while attacking; ordinary concealment in shadows does not apply against darkvision.

description.value: 3/day, a holy elemental can use dimension door, transporting only itself and up to 50 pounds of material. The start and end points of the teleport must be in areas of bright light; if the destination lacks sufficient light, the teleport fails but does not expend the ability for the day.

effect: Self and up to 50 lb. of material, as dimension door. Both endpoints must be in bright light; restore charge if destination fails for insufficient light.

description.value: When a holy elemental deals holy damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

effect: Whenever this elemental deals light damage, including spells and slams. Resolve separately from the damage.

saveDCs.raw: No printed DC; generated from default monster DC.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a holy elemental fires 3 beams of holy energy at its foes, up to 30 feet away. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 2d6 points of holy damage. The rays may be fired at the same or different targets, but all rays must be aimed at targets within 30 feet of each other and fired simultaneously. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).

effect: Three simultaneous rays; may split between targets within 30 feet of each other. On holy damage resolve Dizzy Vision.
Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 21).
Recharge [[1d4]] rounds. Outside combat restore the charge after this interval.
